items.summary: Punctuation and lookalike customer ids were treated as proof of a different customer.
items.repair: Case, width, punctuation, and a small lookalike fold no longer count as PROVEN_DISTINCT. A remaining non-ASCII character also blocks that label. Equal one-to-one amounts are withheld. Unequal one-to-one amounts stay identified as NO_RELATIONSHIP_EVIDENCE.

items.summary: One unbilled job and one orphan payment of the same amount were both identified.
items.repair: That pair is withheld. A one-cent extra payment does not restore the pair. A payment that names the job id is withheld with that job. Several jobs at the same flat rate are not all withheld by one payment.

items.summary: The monitor sidecar write could lose an update across processes, and the website connector treated every loopback port as allowed.
items.repair: The sidecar write takes an exclusive file lock on this host. connector_destination_allowed no longer treats loopback as an implicit allow.

items.summary: Two or more unbilled jobs at the same amount plus an orphan payment of that amount stay identified. Withholding every job would hide unrelated flat-rate work. Pairing one job would invent a match.
items.dollars: Two $100 jobs and one $100 orphan payment identify 300.00. Confirmed recovery stays 0.00.

items.summary: ASCII lookalikes such as Cl versus C1, job ids that differ by punctuation, split payments, and an orphan invoice beside an orphan payment are not folded into a match.
items.reason: Normalizing them would invent a relationship. They remain separate.

items.summary: Deleting the monitor rows, the sidecar, and the anchor together is indistinguishable from a tenant that never wrote. The same principal who holds both server keys can rewrite the chain.
items.reason: No external witness is available. EXTERNAL_ANCHOR stays NOT_VERIFIED.

items.summary: A deletion request does not delete. Retention is not enforced. Backup deletion and legal hold are not implemented.
items.reason: A partial destructive delete would be an unsafe stand-in for a policy decision.

items.summary: XAELI staging was not connected. Jules CCLIII and CCLIV were not found as branches, commits, or pull requests.
items.reason: No live model response was observed. No weights were downloaded.
